free_tier.stated: Per-second billing with no free compute allowance: CNY 0.00003 per vCPU per second, which the page restates as CNY 0.108 per vCPU per hour, range 1 to 8 cores; CNY 0.000015 per GiB per second, or CNY 0.054 per GiB per hour, 512 MiB to 8192 MiB in 512 MiB steps. Each sandbox gets 20 GiB of local disk free of charge. Persistent storage carries 10 GiB per account per month free, then CNY 0.000145 per GiB per hour. Network traffic is not billed separately today. A 2 vCPU / 2 GiB sandbox is CNY 2.61 for an 8-hour day by the page's own worked example.

retention.stated: A sandbox has a 5 minute default lifetime and a 15 second default exec timeout, both extendable through the API; the account itself needs real-name verification ( ) before any free allowance is granted.

the sandbox is fully compatible with the E2B API and SDK, with regions cn-yangzhou-1 and us-south-1, and states a 5 minute default sandbox lifetime
the create call takes a timeout in seconds defaulting to 15, and a timeout endpoint extends a live sandbox

notes: This is the cheapest per-vCPU sandbox rate found, at CNY 0.108 per vCPU-hour, and it is the only provider here that publishes a US region alongside a mainland one. It is recorded as fails-identity because the free allowance is gated on real-name verification and topping up needs a Chinese payment method; the sandbox compute itself has no free allowance at all, so even a verified account starts at CNY 0.432 per hour for 2 vCPU and 4 GiB. Isolation is described as system-level per-instance virtualization; the page does not name the technology. Qiniu also sells (LAS) as an ordinary VPS from CNY 14.2 per month domestic and offers a 2-core / 2 GB instance at CNY 66 per year for new customers in Singapore, Tokyo, Hong Kong and Changshan.
